build_model_from_cfg: build a video model from a config object using the MODEL_REGISTRY and place it on the specified GPU
register_new_model: register a new video model class in the MODEL_REGISTRY so build_model can instantiate it by name
build_model_multi_gpu: build a video model wrapped in DistributedDataParallel for multi-GPU training using the config
review_MODEL_REGISTRY: review the MODEL_REGISTRY to see which video model constructors are registered and available
test_build_model: test the build_model function with a config object to verify GPU allocation and model construction
